name: Shade Miasma
desc: A light, seemingly empty pot that contains a gaseous poison. Despite being sealed, the gas inside is leaking out ever so slightly, so try to keep it away from your face.

eff.name: Increase Resonance Area - Circle
eff.desc1: When used as an ingredient for a circular Alchemy Core, increases the resonance area by [Lv. x 1].

eff.name: Increase Resonance Area - 2nd Stratum
eff.desc1: When used as an ingredient for a slot on the line second closest to the Alchemy Core, increases the resonance area by [Lv. x 1].
